# Get all light gray bar positions (center of each vertical bar)
seg = current_frame.segmentation
light_gray = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w']

bar_centers = []
for n in light_gray:
    b = n['boundary']
    # boundary is [[top, col], [bottom, col]] for vertical bars
    top_row = b[0][0]
    bot_row = b[-1][0]  # last point
    col = b[0][1]
    center_row = (top_row + bot_row) // 2
    bar_centers.append((center_row, col, top_row, bot_row))

print(f"Total bars: {len(bar_centers)}")
print("First 10 bar centers:")
for cr, c, tr, br in bar_centers[:10]:
    print(f"  center=({cr}, {c}), spans rows {tr}-{br}")

# Try clicking on the first bar
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': bar_centers[0][0], 'col': bar_centers[0][1]}])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
